lines: “秦玄，我要你与我双修，让我怀孕......”
天玄大陆，一处名为天墓的禁地之内，一个白衣女子正凌空而立。
女子双目如星，容貌清冷绝美，白衣胜雪，纤腰盈盈一握，偏偏胸前波涛如怒。
只是，此时那这清冷的仙子正满脸红晕，媚态横生，死死盯着眼前的少年，恨不得吃了他一般。
被女子逼到悬崖边的少年急忙摇头。
“让你怀孕？”
“不行，我已有婚约，怎能和你双修？”
秦玄已有婚约，当然不会答应对方。
更何况，他知道这女子名为双修，其实只是将他当成了炉鼎。
要是自己答应双修，一定会被吸成人干！
“哼，既然你不想和我双修，那我就和你双修！”
话音未落，话音刚落，一阵香风吹来，璇玑女帝便扑到秦玄身上，将秦玄压在身下。
秦玄刚一开口，便被红唇封住了嘴唇。
女子本是上界璇玑女帝，修为通天彻地，结果因为夺到传说中的太荒神器炼神鼎，遭遇仇敌围攻，重伤之下，被迫逃到下界。
虽然逃得性命，可此时的她已经是身中奇毒，要是不能和一个元阳未失的男子交合，不久就会身死道消！
几个时辰之后，秦玄一睁开眼便看到一张绝美的脸庞正盯着他看。
夺走秦玄元阳之后，女子的脸色似乎好了一些。
“你，你，无耻！”
秦玄怒斥一声，自己明明拒绝了对方，可这女人竟然对他用强！
说完之后，秦玄扶正要起身。
“哪里走！”
一抹白皙压了下来，将秦玄再次压下。
又是几个时辰之后，秦玄醒了过来。
“你不如杀了我吧！”
秦玄有些绝望的抬头看向璇玑女帝。
“别担心，我不会让你死的，不仅如此，我还可以治好你的丹田伤势。”
听到这里，秦玄顿时又惊又喜地看向璇玑女帝。
他本是大乾王朝火风城秦家少族长。
三年前，为了给未婚妻柳依依治病，秦玄冒险在天墓附近搜寻灵草，结果被人袭击，丹田被废，还被人丢入绝境天墓之中。
好几次，他都差点被天墓中的灵兽所杀，要不是璇玑女帝正好撕开空间通道救下他，只怕他已经死在了天墓中。
要是能治好丹田......
秦玄将希冀的目光看向璇玑女帝，可是看着女帝眼中的贪婪，秦玄不寒而栗，到嘴的话又咽了下去。
几个时辰的折腾，他是一滴都没有了。
“我中的毒太深了，还需要你帮我继续......疗伤！”
秦玄不停摇头。
content_en:
"Qin Xuan, I want you to cultivate with me and make me pregnant..."
On the Tianxuan Continent, in a forbidden area called the Heavenly Tomb, a woman in white was standing in the sky.
The woman's eyes are like stars, her face is cold and beautiful, her white clothes are as white as snow, her waist is slender, but her chest is like waves of anger.
However, at this time, the cold fairy was blushing and charming, staring at the young man in front of her, as if she wanted to eat him.
The boy who was pushed to the edge of the cliff by the woman hurriedly shook his head.
"Getting you pregnant?"
"No, I'm already engaged, how can I practice dual cultivation with you?"
Qin Xuan is already engaged, so of course he will not agree to it.
What's more, he knew that this woman's name was Shuangxiu, but she actually just regarded him as a furnace.
If you agree to double cultivation, you will definitely be sucked into having sex!
"Hmph, since you don't want to practice dual cultivation with me, then I will practice dual cultivation with you!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a gust of fragrant wind blew, and Empress Xuanji threw herself on Qin Xuan and pressed Qin Xuan under her.
"You..."
As soon as Qin Xuan opened his mouth, his lips were sealed by red lips.
"Well..."
...
The woman was originally Empress Xuanji of the upper realm, and her cultivation was astonishing. However, because she had seized the legendary Taihuang artifact, the Divine Refining Cauldron, she was besieged by enemies. She was seriously injured and was forced to flee to the lower realm.
Although she escaped with her life, she was already poisoned by a strange poison at this time. If she could not have sex with a man whose vitality was still intact, she would die soon!
A few hours later, Qin Xuan opened his eyes and saw a beautiful face staring at him.
After taking away Qin Xuan Yuanyang, the woman's complexion seemed to be better.
"You, you, shameless!"
Qin Xuan scolded angrily. He clearly rejected the other party, but this woman actually used force on him!
After finishing speaking, Qin Xuan stood up and stood up.
"Where to go!"
A touch of white skin pressed down, pressing Qin Xuan down again.
...
A few hours later, Qin Xuan woke up.
"You might as well kill me!"
Qin Xuan looked up at Empress Xuanji with some despair.
"Don't worry, I won't let you die. Not only that, I can also heal your Dantian injury."
Hearing this, Qin Xuan looked at Empress Xuanji with surprise and joy.
He was originally the young patriarch of the Qin family in Huofeng City of the Daqian Dynasty.
Three years ago, in order to treat his fiancée Liu Yiyi's illness, Qin Xuan ventured to search for spiritual herbs near the celestial tomb. As a result, he was attacked, his Dantian was destroyed, and he was thrown into the desperate celestial tomb.
Several times, he was almost killed by the spirit beasts in the sky tomb. If Empress Xuanji hadn't happened to tear open the space passage to save him, he might have died in the sky tomb.
If only Dantian could be cured...
Qin Xuan looked expectantly at Empress Xuanji, but seeing the greed in the empress's eyes, Qin Xuan shuddered and swallowed the words that came to his mouth.
After several hours of tossing, he didn't have a drop left.
"I have been poisoned too deeply, and I still need your help to continue...healing!"
"No!"
Qin Xuan kept shaking his head.
